verdict.rationale: Antigravity documents automations such as Scheduled Tasks, skills, hooks, rules and plugins, but nothing in the evidence shows versioning, review, or rollback of those automation definitions. Artifact review and diff viewers apply to the agent's code changes, not to automations. Skills being plain folders that could be put under git is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
